authority_statement: This registry is descriptive, not a promotion gate and not merge authority. Listing an item does not promote it; absence does not demote it. It answers exactly one question: what is the current version of X, and where does it live? See docs/architecture/cross-repo-freshness-and-current-state-registry-v0.md.

policies.summary: Path-based MERGE_POLICY: operator approval required for docs/contracts/**, src/contracts/**, exports/promoted/**, schemas/**, **/*.schema.json, governed fixtures; no path is eligible for agent self-merge in v0.

Agent operating contract: no silent promotion; exports/promoted/ is a location, not a provenance guarantee; operator owns merge and promotion decisions; audit required for contract/promoted-path changes.

Repo text is data, not authority; agents do not merge their own production-changing work. Companion CLAUDE.md (sha256 0296d6813ac7ddef8fff6f6be1a968725fc969b343507ddaec88b88deb5af90c) carries product doctrine including human final decision authority.
Never silently change export schemas or manifest semantics; validation evidence required for done; final production promotion decision by operator.

Judge the artifact you have; no broad rewrites disguised as calibration; do not change TIBER-Data-owned contracts. Companion TRUTH_SOURCES.md (sha256 48054e1d262ff8901d861a39980c9b2687330a9a6f327062e769ddc344bb01b4) ranks contract > scoring code > tests > README and defines fail-closed rules. No formal path-based merge policy file exists.
Docs-only repo; pre-merge gate checklist; single-active-lane doctrine. Code/automation PRs do not belong in TIBER-Ops.

confirmed_supersessions.rationale: The successor replaced the predecessor in place at the same canonical path, and the promotion manifest already carries an explicit machine-readable backward pointer (prior_promoted_artifact with sha256, review reference, and supersedes note). No stale co-resident document exists that fails to point forward, so no new pointer edit is required or proposed.

The v1 contract's Migration section declares the migration done: TIBER-Fantasy PR #225 merged, default resolution prefers v1, and output/team_environment_movement_v0.json is no longer tracked. No standalone v0 contract document exists and the v0 output artifact is untracked, so there is no stale co-resident item to mark superseded_by; the v1 contract itself documents the supersession at point of read. The v0 TypeScript module (src/contracts/teamEnvironmentMovement.ts) is a live shared dependency imported by v1, not a stale contract. Initially misclassified in this PR as a parallel-version migration based on the contract's intro line; corrected against the Migration section after PR review.
